spans.s: शिशिर (I) a. (f. रा) Cool, cold, frigid, बाष्पस्तयोरशीतं शिशिरो बिभेद R.xiv.3.

शिशिर (II) n. 1. Coolness; 2. dew, hoarfrost, जातां मन्ये शिशिरमथितां पद्मिनीं वान्यरूपाम् Megh.ii.20, against Mall.); 3. the cool season (comprising Māgha and Phālguna), वरोरु कालं शिशिराह्वयं श्रुणु Rt.v.
शिशिर (I) a. (f. रा) Cool, cold, frigid, बाष्पस्तयोरशीतं शिशिरो बिभेद R.xiv.3.
शिशिर-अंशु, -किरण, -दीधिति m. the moon, शिशिरकिरणकांतं वासरांतेऽभिसार्य Sis.xi.21, काशैर्मही शिशिरदीधितिना रजन्यः Rt.iii.2.

शिशिर-अंशु, -किरण, -दीधिति m. the moon, शिशिरकिरणकांतं वासरांतेऽभिसार्य Sis.xi.21, काशैर्मही शिशिरदीधितिना रजन्यः Rt.iii.2.
शिशिर-अत्यय, -अपगम m. the spring season, स्वहस्तलूनः शिशिरात्ययस्य K.S.iii.61, R.ix.31.
शिशिर-अत्यय, -अपगम m. the spring season, स्वहस्तलूनः शिशिरात्ययस्य K.S.iii.61, R.ix.31.
शिशिर-काल m. the cool season.
शिशिर-घ्न m. an epithet of Agni.
शिशु m. 1. a child, an infant, चतुर्थे मासि कर्तव्यं शिशोर्निष्क्रमणं गृहात् M.ii.35; 2. the young of any animal, Bh.V.i.106; 3. a boy under eight or sixteen years of age.
शिशु-क्रंद m. the weeping of a child.
शिशु-क्रंदन n. the weeping of a child.
शिशु-गंधा f. a kind of jasmine.
शिशु-पाल m. name of a king. (See App. II.)
शिशु-पाल˚हन् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
शिशु-मार m. the Gangetic porpoise.
शिशु-वाहक, -वाह्यक m. a wild goat.
शिशु-वाहक, -वाह्यक m. a wild goat.
शिशुक m. 1. A child, an infant; 2. a porpoise; 3. the young of any animal.
शिश्न m. The male generative organ, M.xi.104.
शिश्विदान a. (f. ना) 1. Sinful, wicked; 2. holy, pious.
शिश्विदान a. (f. ना) 1. Sinful, wicked; 2. holy, pious.
शिष् (I) vt. 1P (pres. शेषति) To hurt, to kill.
शिष् (II) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. शेषति, शेषयति-ते) To leave a residue.

शिष् (III) vt. 7P (pp. शिष्ट; pres. शिनष्टि) 1. To leave, to leave remaining; 2. to distinguish from others.With अव-, to leave remaining, कियदवशिष्टं रजन्याः Sak.iv., स्तंबेन नीवार इवावशिष्टः R.v.15.With परि-, to leave remaining.With वि-, 1. to distinguish from others, to individualize, R.xvii.62; 2. to augment, पुनरकांडविवर्तनदारुणो विधिरहो विशिनष्टि (v.l.) मनोरुजम् M.M.iv.; 3. (in the pass.) to be preferable or superior, (with an abl.).
शिष् Caus. (शेषयति-ते) With वि-, to excel, to surpass.
शिष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Left, remaining; 2. ordered, commanded; 3. tamed, docile; 4. educated, trained; 5. wise, learned; 8. chief, principal, superior.
शिष्ट (II) m. 1. A man of importance; 2. a wise man; 3. a counsellor.
शिष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Left, remaining; 2. ordered, commanded; 3. tamed, docile; 4. educated, trained; 5. wise, learned; 8. chief, principal, superior.
शिष्ट-आचार m. the practice of wise men, a received usage.
शिष्ट-सभा f. an assembly of learned men.
शिष्टि f. 1. Order, command; 2. rule, government; 3. punishment, chastisement.
शिष्य m. 1. A scholar, a pupil, शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् Bg.ii.7, R.i.92, ii.40; 2. anger, passion.
शिष्य-परंपरा f. a succession of pupils.
सिषाधयिषा f. 1. Wish to effect or accomplish; 2. desire to establish or prove (in logic).
सिसृक्षा f. Wish to create.
सीस n. Lead, M.v.144.
